Web dashboard FundtrackPanel + /app/weekly-budget render correctly with all expected testIDs (fundtrack-panel, fundtrack-add-charge, fundtrack-whatif, fundtrack-open-weekly, weekly-page, weekly-booked, weekly-actions, weekly-source-note, weekly-add-charge, weekly-whatif, weekly-something-changed) and the ChargeEntryDialog exposes the 3 tabs (charge-tab-usual/scan/type). ui_bugs.issue: testID='whatif-revised-h' is only rendered once the async what-if computation finishes (debounce 350ms + network round-trip). A short wait (<2.5s) after opening the sheet returns MISSING. Code is correct (/app/mobile/src/components/fundtrack/WhatIfCareSheet.tsx:131 passes testID to Stat which wraps a View). This is a timing/flakiness consideration for tests, not a functional bug — whatif-close and whatif-book render immediately as expected. Suggest wrapping testID on the outer result container so selector is queryable before compute completes.

action_items: (LOW) Consider moving testID='whatif-revised-h' (or adding an additional wrapper testID) so selectors can resolve even when the async result hasn't yet been computed — avoids flakiness in future e2e tests.

(INFO) Web test runs occasionally missed whatif-dialog / visit-change-dialog selectors on first click due to modal open timing; code paths exist and functionally render — add explicit wait_for_selector in future scripts.

WeeklyBudget mobile screen correctly orders ladder → alerts → booked → actions → used → superseded → pending as per spec; matches web.
